text: Free co-op demo: tiny gnomes, one ship, a very big ocean, and absolutely no idea what they're doing.
Sail from island to island for fuel and food, and patch the leaks when things go wrong.
Things go wrong a lot. Whirlpools, giant waves, and a giant octopus.
Best part: the gnomes have stretchy noodle arms, so even slapping a friend looks ridiculous.
The catch? The islands and menus look pretty basic.
All fifteen demo reviews so far are positive, and it's in thirteen languages.
Think Sea of Thieves, played by Human Fall Flat characters.
Worth a dip with your least reliable friends.
